source_text:
22.6 Καὶ τὸ ε λεός σου καταδιώξεταί με πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς
μου, καὶ τὸ κατοικεῖν με ἐν οι κῳ Κυρίου εἰς μακρότητα ἡμερῶν. Τίς ἐστιν ὁ
καταδιώκων ε λεος; Χριστὸν Θεοῦ δύναμιν ε μαθον καὶ Θεοῦ σοφίαν ἀπὸ τοῦ
ἀποστόλου, καὶ ο τι ἐγεννήθη ἡμῖν σοφία ἀπὸ Θεοῦ, δικαιοσύνη τε καὶ ἁγιασμὸς καὶ
ἀπολύτρωσις. Αὐτὸς λέγει· ̓Εγώ εἰμι ἡ ὁδὸς καὶ ζωὴ καὶ ἀλήθεια. Μάθετε ο τι αὐτός
ἐστιν καὶ ὁ ε λεος ὁ διώκων· ε μψυχος ε λεος σε διώκει. Τοὺς ε λαττον φεύγοντας
κατα λαμβάνει καὶ κρατεῖ, καὶ εἰς τὴν ἐκκλησίαν αὐτοὺς α γει, ι να ἐλεήσῃ καὶ
οἰκήσωσιν εἰς τὸν οι κον Κυρίου, εἰς μακρότητα ἡμερῶν, καὶ εἰς τὴν ἐν οὐρανοῖς
ἁγίαν ἐκκλησίαν, καὶ μακρήμεροι γένωνται.
pass_a_gloss: And the mercy of-you will-pursue me all the days of-the life of-me, and the to-dwell me in house of-Lord into length of-days. Who is the pursuing mercy? Christ of-God power I-learned and of-God wisdom from the apostle, and that he-was-born to-us wisdom from God, righteousness both and sanctification and redemption. Himself he-says: I am the way and life and truth. Learn that himself is also the mercy the pursuing; ensouled mercy you pursues. The less fleeing it-overtakes and holds, and into the church them it-leads, that he-may-have-mercy and they-may-dwell into the house of-Lord, into length of-days, and into the in heavens holy church, and long-dayed they-may-become.
pass_b_english: “And your mercy will pursue me all the days of my life, and my dwelling in the house of the Lord unto length of days” (Psalm 22:6).

Who is the mercy that pursues? I learned Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God from the apostle, and that he was born for us wisdom from God, righteousness and sanctification and redemption. He himself says: “I am the way and life and truth” (John 14:6). Learn that he himself is also the mercy that pursues; living mercy pursues you.

Those who flee less it overtakes and holds, and leads them into the church, that he may have mercy and they may dwell in the house of the Lord, unto length of days, and into the holy church in the heavens, and become long-lived.

choices.term: αὐτός ἐστιν καὶ ὁ ἔλεος ὁ διώκων· ἔμψυχος ἔλεος σε διώκει
choices.english: he himself is also the mercy that pursues; living mercy pursues you
choices.why: The pursuer is Christ as living mercy, not an impersonal attribute. OCR ε λεος / ε μψυχος.
rejected: mercy is an impersonal force beside Christ

choices.english: those who flee less it overtakes
choices.why: ἔλαττον is less-fleeing, not ‘the least people’. OCR ε λαττον.
rejected: it never overtakes those who flee
